migration: 1.0.0 to 1.1.0: anchors made game-agnostic (constants live in the game profile), lens gates added; ids, weights and passAt unchanged; 1.1.0 to 1.1.1: gameProfile generalized to your-game-profile for the public kit and hash recomputed with the documented kit algorithm (spec/RUBRIC_HASH.md); ids, weights, anchors and passAt unchanged; 1.1.1 to 1.1.2: The severity anchor names the project-defined P0 scopes used by the engine. Scoring and fields are unchanged. 1.1.2 to 1.1.3: Evidence descriptions and fixture working directories now refer to the distributed kit. 1.1.3 to 1.1.4: Empty samples and zero case counts earn U. Computed lines require the declared evidence type. 1.1.4 to 1.1.5: Links intake, replays and independent closures to cases and derives the lag-cap requirement from build IDs. 1.1.5 to 1.2.0: Line, pillar and anchor wording made genre-neutral (ids, weights, conditions and pass marks unchanged). 1.2.0 to 1.3.0: Evidence pack names made genre-neutral (matchLinesWithActionCapture to playFindingsWithActionCapture; matchLines to playFindings; routedToGrowth to routedToLinkOwner; share-attribution-intake to share-link-intake). Scoring, weights, conditions and pass marks unchanged; rename these fields in packs made for 1.2.0.
levels: Levels 0 to 4, or U. U earns zero points and excludes the line weight from measured coverage. Record skipped execution as NOT_RUN.

source: Issue records, replay attempts, build identifiers and independent verification evidence.
samplePolicy: Each computed metric group needs a nonempty population. Use the listed sample arrays or positive integer case counts. For other groups supply a positive integer measuredCases from the capture. Empty inputs or zero measured cases earn U and zero points. A measured zero failures is valid.
